action: Darkness under the baptismal. Voices above fade. The pulpit rotates back.

speaker: MADDOX
text: How many times you done that alone?

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Enough.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Where do you even go?

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Past the tree line there is a clearing. Old oak, four feet through. Got a crate. A blanket, a couple books, little food.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Be nice if tomorrow you came with me. Service ends early. Count is at nine-thirty. That is near four hours.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Four hours. Not five minutes. What do you even do with that?

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Sit. Listen. Read. Feel grass through your socks. Hear a car go by where no one is counting you.

speaker: MADDOX
text: That is a dangerous amount of freedom.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Because five minutes feels like mercy. Four hours feels like your life is yours again.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Maybe nothing. For men like us, maybe that is everything.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Then we plan it the same way you plan a yard. Boundaries. No crowds. No lights. No open street.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Four hours of pretending I am not a ghost.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Four hours of remembering you are not one.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: You keep your word. You come back. Every time.

speaker: MADDOX
text: I will.

action: A cell at night. A contraband phone lights a tattooed hand.

speaker: ALLEN
text: Hey, bro. What is up?

speaker: MADDOX
text: Justin's bike. I need you to deliver it somewhere.

speaker: ALLEN
text: No way, man. That is the only thing we got left of Justin.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Listen. I need this.

speaker: ALLEN
text: You sound like you are saying goodbye.

speaker: MADDOX
text: No. No goodbyes. Just do this quiet. No questions. No names. Drop it and walk away.

speaker: ALLEN
text: Yeah. Okay. For Justin. For you.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Thank you, brother.

speaker: MADDOX
text: One last ride, brother. One last ride.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: I am not riding with you on that death trap.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Yes, you are. One more time. Let the wind go through your hair.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: I barely have any hair.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Then the wind will have less to fight.

action: The engine wakes. Two men on an empty road beyond the prison.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Slow down, you lunatic!

speaker: MADDOX
text: You said you wanted to feel alive!

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: I said I wanted air, not judgment day!

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Storage once. Now it is nothing.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: No.

speaker: MADDOX
text: I did not say anything.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: You did not have to.

action: Weeks later. Lights, a bed, shelves of books, the motorcycle against the wall.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: You have ruined my quiet.

speaker: MADDOX
text: You keep coming back though.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Somebody has to make sure you do not turn a tunnel into a subdivision.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Home.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Funny thing about getting old, son. Last night I dreamed about a plate.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Steak. Potatoes. Gravy. Mama used to put too much pepper in the gravy. I would give damn near anything to complain about that gravy one more time.

action: A hot pan. Butter hisses. Three plates.

speaker: ARIANNA
text: Let him have a table.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: What did you do?

speaker: MADDOX
text: Supper.

speaker: MADDOX
text: That bad?

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Too much pepper.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: No. It is right.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: I have not had that meal in fifty-three years. I forgot what it tasted like.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: I thought I was getting too old to carry things. Turns out, I was too old to carry everything.

speaker: MADDOX
text: To Mama.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: To Mama.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: You are a good man, son.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Some days I do not feel like one.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Good. That is how you know you are still trying.

speaker: ARIANNA
text: I hate Sundays.

speaker: MADDOX
text: Why?

speaker: ARIANNA
text: Because this place becomes a tunnel again.

speaker: HARRINGTON
text: Then next Friday we make it a home again.
